phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Analog image intensifier night vision goggles using a third-generation microchannel plate (MCP) image intensifier tube with integrated infrared (IR) illuminator and monocular or binocular optical system.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Third-generation analog image intensifier goggles remain the most widely deployed night vision device in frontline military and defense applications as of 2024 due to their superior low-light performance, proven reliability, and established supply chains compared to thermal or digital variants. The MCP image intensifier tube is the core technology enabling visible image amplification under low light, making it the defining component of these goggles.
